_note: HookSwapPerps market registry — one entry per perp market, FULLY described by config. Copy to markets.json and fill in REAL addresses/feeds. A market = { market, assetClass, oracle:{sourceType,…}, collateralToken?, maxLeverage? }. The oracle.sourceType selects an off-chain adapter from the registry (registry.ts) — adding a venue/feed type is a new adapter MODULE, not a config-schema change and NEVER a Settlement redeploy. Adding a market is just a new entry here (+ an on-chain admin addSupportedToken only if it introduces a NEW collateral token). See EXTENSIBILITY.md. The loader validates SHAPE per sourceType, not on-chain existence. maxLeverage must be <= the on-chain Settlement.MAX_LEVERAGE (100x). Addresses are lowercase placeholders unless marked REAL; replace before use.

markets._comment: REAL, on-chain-verified HookSwap v2 pair on XLayer (196): WOKB/SeedTestToken seeded pool (CLAUDE.md 2026-07-08). quoteToken = WOKB. Illustrative crypto market — proves the AMM path end-to-end.

EXAMPLE — HookSwap v3 crypto market on Robinhood (4663). Fill poolAddress with a real HookSwap v3 pool (v3Factory 0xAa1f5B… in contracts/deployments/robinhood.json); quoteToken = the stable/WETH leg. WETH9 = 0x0Bd7D308…EAcAD73.
EXAMPLE — Uniswap v3 crypto market on Sepolia (11155111, canonical Uniswap stack). Fill poolAddress with the real WETH/USDC v3 pool; quoteToken = USDC.

EXAMPLE — TOKENIZED STOCK. AAPL-PERP priced from a Chainlink AAPL/USD AggregatorV3 feed (external, NOT AMM). feed = the aggregator proxy address (8 decimals typical). This is the RWA/stocks path: NO AMM pool, NO Settlement change — the mark comes from latestRoundData(). Replace `feed` with a real AAPL/USD proxy; collateral = a supported stable.

EXAMPLE — ROBINHOOD CHAIN tokenized stock. NVDA-PERP priced from the Robinhood Chain Chainlink NVDA/USD per-stock proxy (8 decimals). Get the REAL proxy address from https://docs.chain.link/data-feeds/price-feeds/addresses?network=robinhood (do NOT guess). Spot venue is 0x RFQ (NVDA↔USDG) but the AUTHORITATIVE mark is this Chainlink feed. collateralToken = USDG (add via admin addSupportedToken — NOT a redeploy).
EXAMPLE — RWA (gold). XAU-PERP priced from a Chainlink XAU/USD feed. Same external-feed path as stocks; assetClass:'rwa'. Replace `feed`.

EXAMPLE — Pyth-priced market (pull oracle). priceId = the 32-byte Pyth feed id; pythContract = the IPyth receiver on that chain. Fresh price must be posted on-chain (Hermes) or getPriceNoOlderThan reverts → {ok:false}. Replace both.

EXAMPLE — generic allowlisted HTTP price source (last resort). Host is enforced against allowedHost; auth header (if any) comes from an ENV var by name, never from config; pricePath is a dot-path into the JSON. Set signerEnv to require a signed attestation (TODO: wire scheme).
